The '''2016 [[Copa Libertadores]] second stage''' was played from 16 February to 21 April 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/04012016-1824/bridgestone-libertadores-fechas-y-horarios-definidos|title=Bridgestone Libertadores: fechas y horarios definidos|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 January 2016|language=Spanish}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the second stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2016 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2016 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento_copa_libertadores_2016_-_edicion_final.pdf|title=Copa Bridgestone Libertadores 2016 – Reglamento|language=Spanish|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
The draw of the tournament was held on 22 December 2015, 20:30 PYST ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/25092015-1003/el-22-de-diciembre-se-realizara-el-sorteo-de-la-copa-libertadores|title=El 22 de diciembre se realizará el sorteo de la Copa Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=25 September 2015|language=Spanish}}</ref><ref name="entries">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/18122015-1937/sorteo-de-la-copa-bridgestone-libertadores-se-acerca-la-gran-cita|title=Sorteo de la Copa Bridgestone Libertadores: se acerca la gran cita|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=18 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/21122015-1702/la-copa-bridgestone-libertadores-toma-forma-tras-un-emocionante-sorteo|title=La Copa Bridgestone Libertadores toma forma tras un emocionante sorteo|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 December 2015|language=Spanish}}</ref>

Starting from this season, teams were seeded by the newly established ''CONMEBOL ranking of the Copa Libertadores'' (except for teams from Mexico which were not ranked and thus seeded last in all draws),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/26112015-1400/importantes-decisiones-del-comite-ejecutivo|title=Importantes decisiones del Comité Ejecutivo|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=26 November 2015|accessdate=18 December 2015|language=Spanish|quote=la utilización del Ranking de Clubes para establecer los cabezas de serie de cada grupo así como también los demás equipos que integrarán las distintas líneas para el sorteo}}</ref><ref name="seeding">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/21122015-1703/se-lanza-el-ranking-conmebol-de-copa-libertadores|title=Se lanza el Ranking CONMEBOL de Copa Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 December 2015|accessdate=21 December 2015|language=Spanish}}</ref> taking into account of the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/en/conmebol-ranking-copa-libertadores|title=Conmebol Ranking of the Copa Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=2016-10-27|archive-date=2015-12-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222132344/http://www.conmebol.com/en/conmebol-ranking-copa-libertadores|url-status=dead}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 2006–2015
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 1960–2005
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years
<onlyinclude>{{#invoke:transcludable section|main|section=Draw|text=
For the second stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups of four containing a team from each of the four pots. The defending champions ([[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]]) were automatically placed first in Pot 1 and allocated to Group 1 for the draw. The remaining teams were seeded based on their CONMEBOL ranking (shown in parentheses).<ref name="seeding"/> Teams from the same association in Pots 1, 2 and 3 could not be drawn into the same group. Teams from Mexico were allocated to Pot 4, together with the winners of the first stage, whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and they could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.<ref name="procedure">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/21122015-1749/pautas-y-formato-de-sorteo-copa-bridgestone-libertadores-2016|title=Pautas y formato de sorteo Copa Bridgestone Libertadores 2016|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 December 2015|accessdate=21 December 2015|language=Spanish}}</ref>

The six winners of the [[2016 Copa Libertadores first stage|first stage]] which joined the 26 direct entrants were as follows:
*[[2016 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G1|Winner G1]]: {{flagicon|COL}} [[Independiente Santa Fe|Santa Fe]]
*[[2016 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G2|Winner G2]]: {{flagicon|ARG}} [[Club Atlético Huracán|Huracán]]
*[[2016 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G3|Winner G3]]: {{flagicon|ARG}} [[Racing Club de Avellaneda|Racing]]
*[[2016 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G4|Winner G4]]: {{flagicon|URU}} [[Club Atlético River Plate (Montevideo)|River Plate]]
*[[2016 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G5|Winner G5]]: {{flagicon|ECU}} [[Independiente del Valle]]
*[[2016 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G6|Winner G6]]: {{flagicon|BRA}} [[São Paulo FC|São Paulo]]

==Format==
<onlyinclude>{{#invoke:transcludable section|main|section=Format|text=
In the second stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams were ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss). If tied on points, the following criteria would be used to determine the ranking: 1. [[Goal difference]]; 2. Goals scored; 3. Away goals scored; 4. Drawing of lots (Regulations Article 5.1).<ref name="regulations"/> The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2016 Copa Libertadores final stages|round of 16]].
}}</onlyinclude>
==Groups==
The fixture list was determined by the draw as follows:<ref name="procedure"/>
*'''Round 1''': Team 3 vs. Team 1, Team 4 vs. Team 2
*'''Round 2''': Team 1 vs. Team 4, Team 2 vs. Team 3
*'''Round 3''': Team 2 vs. Team 1, Team 3 vs. Team 4
*'''Round 4''': Team 1 vs. Team 2, Team 4 vs. Team 3
*'''Round 5''': Team 4 vs. Team 1, Team 3 vs. Team 2
*'''Round 6''': Team 1 vs. Team 3, Team 2 vs. Team 4

The matches were played on 16–18, 23–25 February, 1–3, 8–10, 15–17 March, 5–7, 12–14 and 19–21 April 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_copa_bridgestone_libertadores.pdf|title=Fixture Copa Bridgestone Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
